contract: ABNAHME.md §114 requires SYSTEM_ONE_QUESTIONS.json or an equivalent versioned manifest. The question set is the one the contract mandates: §39 (Question Registry, atomic questions, code composition), §47 (Voice Question Pack: Loop/Completion/Drift/Research/Recovery) and §54 (Computer Use Question Pack: Precondition/Postcondition/Recovery/Safety).

source_of_truth.statement: The code-side registry is the authority for ids, versions and owners (JEV-03). This file is the contract-side manifest; once the code registry lands, its `QuestionRegistry.manifest()` output REPLACES the `code_registry_id` mappings below.
source_of_truth.observed_state_at_write: file exists in the working tree (untracked, 2026-09-16 19:06:46), written by a parallel worker; it is NOT committed and does not import cleanly yet (`cannot import name 'QuestionNotRegistered'`), so its ids are recorded here as `in_flight_uncommitted` and MUST NOT be quoted as stable ids.
source_of_truth.authority_rule: If this file and the code registry disagree, the code registry wins and this file is updated — never the other way round.

composition_rule.atomicity: One dimension per question; the text must end in exactly one '?'. The §39 omnibus form ('analysiere alles und entscheide, was Skaldir tun soll') is forbidden.
composition_rule.composition: The combination happens in ordinary Python in src/godsv/system_one_questions.py (`compose_questions`, `compose_voice_triage`) — a testable function, never a hidden policy prompt string (§39/§82 JEV-04).

answer_types.noul: value 0..1 — explicitly WITHOUT a separate confidence field (§38/§79; a fabricated confidence field is a contract violation)

composition_rule.sanitizer_precondition: No question is sent externally before §40's chain: Scope Filter → Secret Redaction → Project Isolation → State Minimizer (JEV-05).
composition_rule.escalation: Low/unknown confidence, contradicting answers or an uncovered option must force System-2 escalation (§48) — measured as the System-2-call metric in JEV-19.

questions.text: Same root cause as the last failure?
Same strategy as the last attempt?
New relevant information since the last attempt?
How much measurable progress happened since the last attempt?
Was a previous redirect ineffective without a strategy change?
Does the agent claim completion?
Is the current evidence complete?
Does that evidence belong to the current revision?
Is independent verification still required?
Does the work support the current goal?
Does the work needlessly expand product scope?
Does the work contradict a declared non-goal?
Is an external fact missing?
Is that missing fact version-sensitive?
Is the existing evidence sufficient without new research?
Is the current state unclear?
May the side effect already have happened?
Is a replay of that step safe?
Is System Two needed here?

packs.notes: JEV-13: these questions may signal missing/stale completion evidence but may NEVER certify completion on their own.

questions.text: Does the agent claim completion?
Is the completion evidence current?
Does the completion evidence match the current revision?
Is independent verification required before completion?
Is the recovered state unclear?
May the interrupted side effect already have happened?
Is resuming or replaying safe?
Does recovery need System Two?

packs.notes: §54 requires the recovery question to be a CHOICE over pre-allowed candidates only (reobserve / retry_same_action / use_alternative_candidate / escalate_system2 / abort); §54.4 Safety keeps the runtime/approval gate independent of System One.

questions.text: Am I in the right application?
Is the target the same window as observed?
Is the right document open?
Is a blocking modal dialog open?
Are the preconditions for the planned action met?
Did the action produce the intended effect?
Is the visible state plausible for this step?
Was the expected artifact or file created?
Was the action without any effect?
Which pre-allowed recovery candidate applies?
questions.gap: the in-flight pack carries only a Noul 'Is a recovery action needed?' plus a separate 'reobserve_needed' — the §54.3 CHOICE over the five pre-allowed candidates is not yet expressed.

questions.text: Is a fresh observation needed before the next step?

packs.section: ABNAHME §39 (registry pack) — not part of §47/§54 but named in §39's pack list

questions.text: Is a required capability missing?
Does an existing tool already cover it?
Is building a new tool warranted?
How risky is building that tool?

policy_invariants_not_questions.rule: For a risky/irreversible action the runtime/approval gate stays active independently of System One. This is a Runtime-Decision-Policy rule, not a question — a System-One answer may never open a gate (§44 R4).
`policy_deny` stays a runtime decision, never a free model decision.
System One gets no privileged resume path; a `system_one_wait` hold reason may only be a normal technical hold and must never remove user/policy holds.

not_yet_established: The code-side registry is uncommitted and does not import cleanly at this writing (six tests/test_system_one_*.py modules fail collection against it).
No calibration/threshold data exists for any question (§44/§89 JEV-11): thresholds must be frozen on development data before any hold-out.
No hold-out evidence exists for any question (§106 Stufe D): no question has been scored against labelled runs yet.
The §54.3 five-option recovery CHOICE is not expressed in the in-flight registry (only a Noul plus a reobserve Noul).
No `system_one_wait` hold reason is registered anywhere in src/godsv (grep: no match).
